photos.title: Myrtle Beach oceanfront condo and hotel towers, south of downtown, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: Oceanfront condo and hotel towers south of downtown Myrtle Beach, seen from a plane over the ocean, with the beach, pools and the streets behind.
photos.caption: Oceanfront condo towers south of downtown Myrtle Beach, near three of the busiest buildings in the table above. This stretch is in a zone where nightly rentals are allowed.
photos.alt: A row of oceanfront condo and hotel towers of 10 to 15 floors with pools in front, above a beach with umbrellas, seen from a plane over the ocean in Myrtle Beach
photos.author: U.S. Geological Survey
photos.credit: Photo: U.S. Geological Survey, public domain. Credit not required; give it anyway.
photos.provenance: U.S. government photo: USGS baseline coastal oblique aerial survey 11CCH03 (Ponte Vedra, Florida, to the South Carolina/North Carolina border), flown 2011-08-24, photographer Karen L.M. Morgan (USGS). Frame 2011_0824_175948d.jpg from https://coastal.er.usgs.gov/data-release/doi-F7N877XX/data/11CCH03_0824_175500.zip; aircraft position 33.674683 N, -78.891968 W (11CCH03-Photolocations.csv and the file's EXIF GPS; the position of the plane, not of the buildings). Data release: Morgan, K.L.M., 2017, https://doi.org/10.5066/F7N877XX. Not the frame used on any other page (other pages use 174830, 175156, 175537, 180052, 180608 and 181208).

photos.subject_check: Looked at full size (3008 px, in two halves) by the writer on 2026-11-02. Points 350 to 450 m inland of the plane, 250 m either side, all fall in the shaded (nightly rentals) class. The plane was about 300 to 700 m from the points of the four busiest buildings in findings oceanfront.top_buildings (Tides/Driftwood/Oasis 33.67493,-78.8983; Coral Beach 33.67587,-78.89752; Landmark 33.67336,-78.90088), so the caption says 'where the busiest buildings stand', not which tower is which. A small flag hangs on one balcony; no logo or readable sign; people on the beach are too small to recognize.
